 Exclusive 'GMA' digital Deals & Steals Holiday Gift Guide 
 5:41 Tory Johnson reflects on 20 years at 'GMA', 'Deals and Steals' and more Pop's Birding, SPONGELLE, Velvet Eyewear, Wabi Whiffs, Adobe By Tory Johnson Video by Will Linendoll and Brittany Berkowitz November 09, 2026, 10:03 AM 
 It's Tory Johnson's exclusive "GMA" digital   Deals   &   Steals Holiday Gift Guide!
 You can score big savings on products from brands such as MADMIA, Solawave and more. The deals start at just $2.50 and are up to 69% off. Find all of Tory Johnson's   Deals   &   Steals   on her website,   GMADeals.com .
 Deal details: 
 Use the links   be low on date(s) listed to receive the savings. Only while supplies last. No back orders, unless specified by the individual vendor. No rain checks. Contact retailers for questions about products   be fore ordering. Shipping rates are valid in the continental U.S. only. 
 NEED HELP? CONTACT TORY:   If you need assistance with a deal, email Tory Johnson and her team directly at   help@gmadeals.com .
 By clicking on these shopping links, visitors will leave   ABCNews.com   and   GoodMorningAmerica.com , and these e-commerce sites are operated under different terms and privacy policies.   ABC and Tory Johnson will receive a commission for purchases made through these links.   Prices may change from date of publication. Have questions about ordering or a purchase? Click   here . 
 50% off MADMIA MADMIA: Socks
 Inspire creativity and encourage self-expression with MADMIA's playful, crazy, colorful socks. Designed to encourage everyone to let their creativity run wild and to not be afraid to stand out from the crowd. Choose from a large assortment, including KPop Demon Hunters, Mickey and Mini Mouse, Winnie the Pooh, Hello Kitty, the Grinch, holiday designs, colorful rainbows and more. Toddler size fits ages 3 to 5; Kids and Adults fit ages 6 to 99. Shipping is $2.90. $13 - $15 
 $26 - $30 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off USB LIGHTER CO. USB LIGHTER CO.: Rechargeable Lighters
 Light up with eco-conscious lighters. Instead of butane, USB Lighter Co. lighters recharge as easily as your phone. Great for candles, camping, stoves and fireplaces -- anytime you need a light. With hundreds of lights per charge, these come in handy daily and they make great, easy gifts. Shipping is $4.99 or free over $25. $10 to $15 + Free Shipping 
 $20 - $30 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 52% to 53% off Solawave Solawave: Skin Care Devices
 Gift radiant skin with Solawave. Featuring exclusive WrinkleBoost Tech, the Wrinkle Retreat Pro Light Therapy Mask simultaneously floods the skin with four high-power wavelengths to reach deeper than ever before. This clinical-grade system targets multiple layers of skin at once to revive dullness, fatigue and soften deep lines. The Neck & Chest Pro Light Therapy Mask uses four clinical wavelengths to target the thin and delicate skin on the neck and chest, helping to fade sun spots and firm up crepey skin without any pain or downtime. Eye Recovery Pro targets signs of aging around your eyes with 3-minute sessions to help visibly brighten dark circles and reduce puffiness for a refreshed, brighter look. The 4-in-1 Wand combines red light, massage, current and warmth to rejuvenate skin in each 12-minute session. Free shipping! $79 to $189 + Free Shipping 
 $169 - $399 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Keenz Keenz: MOOV Stroller Wagons
 Ride in luxury and stability for any family adventure. The KEENZ MOOV features elevated, reclining seats with multiple seating configurations, giving families the flexibility to comfortably accommodate kids as their needs change. All-terrain rubber wheels and adjustable push-and-pull handles make the MOOV easy to maneuver, whether you're heading to the park, traveling or tackling a full family day out. Thoughtful details like an insulated cooler bin, activity/snack tray, cup holder, generous storage, and four accessory hooks help keep kids comfortable and everything parents need within reach. Choose from two- and four-passenger designs. Limit one per order. Shipping is $19.99 in the contiguous U.S. $275 - $325 
 $550 - $650 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off MODGY MODGY: Lanterns and Books
 Fill your home with artful design. MODGY's light books are a unique combination of art, literature and light. Designed to look like a beautiful book, they open up to 180 degrees to reveal a warm LED glow, creating an eye-catching accent light that's decorative when closed and illuminated when open. Light books are cordless, rechargeable and easy to display on a bookshelf, desk, nightstand, or table. Available in a wide variety of art- and literature-inspired designs. Luminary lanterns transform from flat to festive in seconds, creating a warm, inviting glow for any occasion. Simply fill it halfway with water, insert the included rechargeable LED tealight and watch the vibrant artwork come to life. Origami lanterns combine beautiful artwork with warm LED illumination, creating a striking, reusable lighting solution. Rechargeable, dimmable and each comes with a USB-C charging cord. Shipping is $6.95 or free over $45. $7.50 - $22.50 
 $15 - $45 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Tree-Free Greetings Tree-Free Greetings: Greeting Cards
 Send holiday greetings with beautiful greeting cards. Tree-Free's cards are printed using VOC-free ink in Keene, New Hampshire, on 100% post-consumer recycled paper that is Process Chlorine Free. Art is at the heart of Tree-Free Greetings, partnering with independent artists and turning their creations into something that can be shared, mailed, displayed and become part of a meaningful moment. Every design includes the brand's signature ARTvelopes: full-color coordinating envelopes that extend the artwork and make the entire piece feel special before the card is even opened. Choose from a big assortment of holiday and everyday greetings, each a set of 16 cards and ARTvelopes. Free shipping! $12.50 + Free Shipping 
 $25 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off INVISASOX INVISASOX: No-show Socks
 Get comfort that you can feel but not see. Invisasox are made with a revolutionary gel heel grip mesh design that keeps the sock on better than any other no show sock -- guaranteed to stay on. The super soft, breathable material molds to your foot while the collar is designed to rest on top of your skin loosely, without that tight, digging in feeling. The"mold around the toes" fit lets your toes spread out naturally for optimal comfort. Choose from neutral colors in packs of three for men and women. Shipping is $3.95 or free over $30. $11 
 $22 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Stingray Spot Remover Stingray Spot Remover: Cleaning Solution
 Erase stains like magic. From automotive grease stains, juice spills on the carpet, makeup, pets, or even as a laundry pre-spotter, Stingray Spot Remover gets the job done. The solution works by penetrating deep into the fibers, helping to break down stains on contact, without discoloring the affected area, which is why it was named an Oprah Favorite after a costume designer instantly removed chocolate from Oprah's white pants while backstage at a Broadway show. Stingray Spot Remover is nontoxic, biodegradable, and has no added scents, so it is safe to have around your family and pets. Available in quart, gallon and two spot-spray-sized options. Shipping is $3.99 or free over $38. $12.50 - $26.50 
 $25 - $53 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Bunnies and Bows Bunnies and Bows: Personalized Gifts and Holiday
 Bring a thoughtful personality to everyday items. For 30 years, Bunnies and Bows has been creating whimsical, personalized products that add a touch of charm to any home. The pillowcases are soft and machine-washable and dryable, with special designs including holiday ready celebrations. Tea towels are made of 100% flour sack cotton, used to wipe away crumbs left behind, as a colorful place setting for a holiday dinner or simply as bright decor for the heart of your home. Customizable designs help make it your own. Designs without personalization are also available. Shipping is $4.99 or free over $40. $7.50 - $17.50 
 $15 - $35 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off SPONGELLE SPONGELLE: Body Wash Infused Buffers
 Cleanse, exfoliate and nourish with SPONGELLE's Body Buffers. Simply wet and squeeze to release the lather. This all-in-one beauty treatment is custom-blended with unique fragrances. Holiday Gingerbread, and Nutcracker boast festive scents. Kid's designs include "Bluey," Crayola and animals. Men's buffers come with a heavy duty scrubber. Free shipping! $6 to $16 + Free Shipping 
 $12 - $32 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off SneakERASERS SneakERASERS: Shoe Cleaner
 Keep your sneakers looking like new. SneakERASERS help quickly remove scuffs, dirt, and everyday grime from white soles and smooth sneaker surfaces, extending the life and appearance of the shoes you already own. The seasonal bundle includes eight individually packaged, pre-moistened SneakERASERS with a fresh pine scent for quick and convenient shoe cleaning. Ready to use with no water needed. AutoERASERS are pre-moistened, ready-to-use cleaning wipes that make it easy to refresh vehicle interiors and everyday touchpoints in seconds. Keep them in your glove box, center console, or trunk for quick cleanups whenever spills, fingerprints, dust and everyday messes happen. Golf Cleaning Bundle is also available. Shipping is $2.99. $15 - $18.50 
 $30 - $37 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Audien Hearing Audien Hearing: Hearing Aids
 Give the gift of better hearing from Audien. The Atom X is a touchscreen-controlled hearing aid featuring CaseControl technology, making it easy to adjust modes and volume directly from a built-in touchscreen on the portable charging case -- no app, no tiny buttons, no hassle. The Ion Pro 2 is Audien's most advanced hearing aid yet, allowing you to switch between six hearing modes with dual directional microphones that help you locate where voices come from and keep them clear in noisy spaces. Bluetooth capability allows you to make calls and stream music right to your hearing aids. The classic Atom Pro 2 for everyday clarity and comfort is also available. Free shipping! $144 to $344.50 + Free Shipping 
 $289 - $689 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 65% to 66% off Gotze Gotze: Peelers and Shears
 Make meal prep quick, clean and fun. Gotze peelers and shears are made of stainless steel and uniquely designed to tackle every job. The 3-in-1 Kitchen Shears are the ultimate combination of a knife and mini cutting board in one sleek kitchen tool -- perfect for slicing vegetables, fruits, meats, and more, and especially helpful for seniors and quick meals. Laser beam-forged blades stay sharp over time, and the sharp cutting edge is ideal for chopping, dicing and slicing. The nonslip handle gives you a comfortable grip for precise control. The Peeler Set includes the Professional Peeler, which works up and down for maximum speed. The Julienne Slicer turns vegetables into perfect noodles in seconds, while the mini-mandolin attachment transforms your peeler into a compact mandolin for uniform slices. Shipping is $4.99 or free over $149. $70 - $100 
 $200 - $300 
 30d 15h 19m 
 • 
 Per pair 
 Shop Now 66% to 69% off Linens Hutch Linens & Hutch: Bedding
 Give your bed an effortless upgrade with standout, comfortable pieces from Linens & Hutch. Outfit any couch, chair or bed with cozy, chunky knit blankets. The sheet sets come in a wide variety of colors that appeal to the whole family, so everyone can choose their favorite, with the classic styles double brushed for an ultra-soft and cozy texture. Down-alternative comforter sets are lightweight yet cozy enough for all seasons. The 100% Cotton Waffle Weave Bed Blanket is also available. Free shipping! $30 to $91 + Free Shipping 
 $99 - $269 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Wabi Whiffs Wabi Whiffs: Odor Eliminators
 Eliminate bathroom odors with Wabi Whiffs. The heart-shaped Fizzy Toilet Bombs are made with natural essential oils, biodegradable glitter and non-staining color that eliminate odor instantly when sprinkled or dropped in the toilet. The TooT Spray is a water based fine mist water air freshener and odor eliminator, ideal for bathroom, trash, kitchen and pet odors. Travel Duos come with one TooT Spray and one 12-pack box of sprinkles. Stay prepared with Essentials Pouches, a go bag ready with sprinkles (on the go toilet bombs), spray and cleansing wipes. Potty training gift sets turn potty training into a confidence-boosting celebration. Shipping is $4.99 or free over $65. $4 - $17 
 $8 - $34 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Prepared Hero Prepared Hero: Safety Supplies
 Give the gift of preparedness this holiday season. Never worry about a blackout with the Backup Light. The 4-in-1 design features a night light, power failure light, detachable flashlight, and emergency light. Designed to automatically turn on during power failures -- keep it plugged in and charging so it's always ready. Fire Blankets are designed to extinguish small fires with no mess. Simply deploy the blanket by pulling down the tabs, and cut off the fire's oxygen supply -- useful in kitchens, cars, camping and more. Compact and easy to store in a ready-to-hang pouch, they're designed to be accessible whenever you need them. Flame-resistant apron doubles as an emergency fire blanket and withstands heat up to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. The Fire Kit comes with multiple fire blankets, Fire Spray, wall hooks, a safety checklist magnet and alert window decal. Additional supplies are available. Limit 50 per product. Free shipping! $17.50 to $80 + Free Shipping 
 $35 - $160 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off ROGUE INDUSTRIES ROGUE INDUSTRIES: Wallets and Accessories
 Nobody likes a bulky, overstuffed wallet. The ROGUE Front Pocket Wallet is the solution. The thin, streamlined design fits perfectly in a man's front pocket. Leather and nylon styles are available. The Ostrich Print Clutch is made of premium Napa leather and embossed with a unique ostrich print. RFID-blocking material is stitched directly into the lining of the wallet, guarding your credit cards from unauthorized access and protecting you from identity theft. RFID Blocking Credit Card Sleeves prevent unauthorized access to your credit cards by creating a metallic shield around your card that blocks skimming attacks. Additional leather accessories are also available. Shipping is $5.50 or free with two or more. $5 - $94 
 $10 - $188 
 Valid: 11/09/2026 to 11/09/2026 
 Shop Now 50% off REVITALIGN REVITALIGN: Shoes
 Treat your feet to a little extra love. REVITALIGN offers fashionable styles in comfort-wellness footwear. This orthotic-based footwear is approved by the American Podiatric Medical Association. The Full Contact Comfort orthotic footbed is designed to provide arch and metatarsal support. Plush faux-fur lined perforated clogs cushion every step, and cozy slippers transition from home to errands easily. Boots and more are available, plus styles for men, too. Shipping is $4.99 or free with two or more. $15 - $85 
 $30 - $170 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 51% off Feets Feets: Foot Masks
 Pamper feet with Feets. The Feets Foot Peel Mask is enriched with natural extracts, designed to gently shed dead, callused skin to reveal smoother-looking and softer-feeling feet over the course of two weeks. For more immediate results, the Hydrating Foot Mask will refresh and moisturize tired feet in just 15-20 minutes. Each bootie comes pre-filled, designed to fit most feet comfortably. Limit 20 per order. Free shipping! $29 + Free Shipping 
 $60

 • 
 Per bundle 
 Shop Now 50% off PopsBirding Pop's Birding: Hummingbird Swings, Nectar and Seed
 Inspired by the observation that hummingbirds spend the majority of their time perching in trees post-feeding, Pop's created a swing to serve as a resting perch that also gave enthusiasts the chance to observe these magical birds. Simply place your swing near a feeder or nectar-rich flowering plant to create the ideal perching spot for hummingbirds to rest and keep watch over their food source. The AspenPerch Hummingbird feeder creates a comfortable perch that mimics nature to keep hummingbirds relaxed and feeding longer. Pop's proprietary nectars, Nectarade and Nectarlyte, are made to mimic nature using 100% pure cane sugar and all-natural ingredients, with all the beneficial nutrients found in nature, so hummingbirds can thrive. Hummingbird & Butterfly Wildflower Seed mix is specially designed to attract hummingbirds to your yard. Shipping is $4.99. $2.50 - $18.50 
 $5 - $37 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% to 60% off Henne Organics Henné Organics: Lip and Skin Care
 Elevate lip care with Henné Organics, handcrafted in the U.S. in small batches for freshness and efficacy. Don't let dry lips hold you back from wearing color. With a nontoxic and moisturizing formula, the Luxury Lip Tints give you long-lasting hydration while adding a beautiful pop of color to your lips. The organic lip balm is formulated to provide long-lasting moisturization for instant relief and lips that stay soft and hydrated all day long. Masks, serums, exfoliators, and sets, plus face cream and oil are also available. Shipping is $4.99 or free over $35. $3.50 - $57 
 $7 - $143 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Pedi Couture Pedi Couture: Sandals and Socks
 Experience elevated comfort during pedicures, at-home relaxation and restorative movement. Designed for maximum comfort, Pedi Couture's toe separator sandals are practical and time-saving, ensuring pedicures don't get ruined. Sandals are easy to slip on, preventing smudging and providing immediate and soothing relief from aching and swelling. A high density foam foot sole supports arches and helps absorb shock, while Pedi Couture's patented cushioned four-post design separates toes comfortably and evenly. Moisturizing Gel Heel Socks are designed with a soft, flexible gel lining -- helping lock in moisture and enhance the effectiveness of your favorite foot cream or lotion. Simply slip them on and relax while they soften, smooth, and deeply hydrate rough heels. Shipping is $3.95. $7.50 - $17.50 
 $15 - $35 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 67% off Velvet Eyewear Velvet Eyewear: Polarized Sunglasses
 Shield the sun in style with Velvet Eyewear, which has been designing sunglasses for women for over 25 years, focusing on fit, facial proportions, comfort, and beautiful, distinctive styles. Polarized styles help reduce distracting glare and improve visual comfort in bright sunlight while providing 100% UVA and UVB protection. From classic silhouettes to modern statement frames, finding the perfect pair has never been easier. Every pair includes a protective folding eyewear case and a matching microfiber cleaning cloth. The case conveniently folds flat to fit inside your purse when not storing sunglasses. Free shipping! $29 + Free Shipping 
 $89 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Softies Softies: Holiday Lounge & Pajama Sets
 Cozy up in holiday ready designs. Softies classic cable knit set is made with their beloved marshmallow fabric, in a rich Christmas green and a gorgeous holiday red, with flared sleeves and a flared pant that look festive and polished whether you’re by the fire or headed to a holiday party. Notch Collar pajama sets are perfect for holiday mornings – made from Softies’ silky soft sleep fabric that feels amazing on your skin, in a classic button-front notch collar style. Limit six per order. Shipping is $9.99 or free with two or more. $70 - $89 
 $140 - $179 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 52% to 61% off Sterling Forever Sterling Forever: Jewelry
 Accessorize with dazzling, sparkling jewelry from Sterling Forever. All eyes will be on you with classic tennis styles, layering chains, bold, colorful rings and hoops that easily dress up your daytime look and elevate an evening vibe. Experience the blend of elegance, versatility and quality craftsmanship with every piece. Free shipping! $12 to $149 + Free Shipping 
 $25 - $388 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off FluffCo FluffCo: Pillows, Pillowcases & Robes
 Bring the high-end hotel experience home at a price that makes sense with FluffCo. Available in standard and king, choose from the down feather or down alternative pillow in soft or firm. Soft pillows, ideal for stomach, back and combination sleepers, have a little less Fluff for more “squish” while still supportive. Firm pillows, best for side sleepers, are filled with extra Fluff for higher loft and added support. The 5-star hotel-quality pillowcases are made by the same suppliers that sell to luxury hotel chains around the world in standard/queen & king. The Silk pillowcases are crafted from luxurious100% mulberry silk, exceptionally smooth, reducing friction, helping to minimize hair breakage and facial creases, making it the ultimate beauty sleep accessory. Robes are also available. Shipping is $4.99. $14.50 - $69.50 
 $29 - $139 
 30d 15h 19m 
 Shop Now 50% off Cozy Earth Cozy Earth: Blankets, Bath, Socks & Accessories
 Gift the gift of cozy. Cozy Earth is a fan favorite for a reason. From ultra cuddly blankets to absorbent, plush bath robes, Cozy Earth products are made to outlast fast-fading fabrics. Essential Socks are the ideal blend of comfort and style, with no show, ankle, quarter and calf options. The Cuddle blanket is indulgently soft, made with ultra-plush faux fur in elevated colors. Lounge socks, scrunchies and more. Free shipping! $7 to $479 + Free Shipping 
 $14 - $958 
 30d 15h 19m

 Check off everyone on your list with BREED. From modern, sleek stainless steel bottle openers and TSA approved grooming kits to genuine leather wallets and polarized sunglasses, there’s no shortage of giftable choices. The personal hand-held massager is a pocket-sized gift for stress relief and comfort. Free shipping! $17 to $44 + Free Shipping
